data.name: Alodi
data.gender_notes: Alodi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'alos' meaning 'not' and 'odos' meaning 'way' or 'path'. Alodi can be interpreted as 'not a way' or 'without a path', suggesting a noble warrior who forges his own way or defies the expected norms. The name Alodi carries the meaning “Noble warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alodi usually hope their child will grow to embody noble warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
